title: The detector that does not exist: intents produced vs tickets the account actually received
note:
OPERATOR DECISION 2026-09-21, asked and answered: BUILD IT, AND FOR ALL ACCOUNTS -- not scoped to prop. [!] THE FACT THAT MOTIVATES IT: breakout_1 produced 21 intents over 22 days and received ZERO tickets, and NOTHING IN THE SYSTEM FIRES ON THAT. The operator found it by noticing an absence, which is the worst available discovery method and the second time today. [!] THE SIZING-REFUSAL PING SHIPPED IN #12696 DOES NOT SUBSTITUTE: no refusal occurred. A BLOCKED account and an UNREACHED account are different failures, and only the first has a signal. [!] SHAPE: for every live leg, intents produced vs orders/tickets its account received over a rolling window, with the read-state DISTINGUISHABLE from zero -- 'we could not look' must never render as 'nothing was starved'. That is the whole point; a detector with a collapsed state is the bug it is meant to catch. [!] GENERALISES PAST PROP by the operator's explicit choice: the same blindness applies to any account whose only leg loses an election to a sibling routed elsewhere.
